local xk9w = game:GetService("Players")
local qm7t = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local bv3r = game:GetService("HttpService")
local tz5b = require(qm7t.Modules:WaitForChild("Database"))

local hy2n
for _, v in next, getgc(true) do
    if type(v) == "table" and rawget(v, "Items") and rawget(v, "Changed") and rawget(v, "Updated") and rawget(v, "_lookup_id") and rawget(v, "ItemAdded") and rawget(v, "ItemRemoved") then
        hy2n = v
        break
    end
end

local wz8p
for _, v in next, getgc(true) do
    if type(v) == "table" and rawget(v, "CurrentData") and rawget(v, "PlayerDataAdded") then
        wz8p = v
        break
    end
end

local nf4q
for _, v in next, getgc(true) do
    if type(v) == "table" and rawget(v, "PlayCheer") and rawget(v, "PlayCheers") then
        nf4q = v
        break
    end
end

local jx6v
for _, v in next, getgc(true) do
    if type(v) == "table" and rawget(v, "SetSkin") and rawget(v, "SetHats") and rawget(v, "SetEffects") and rawget(v, "SetOwner") and rawget(v, "CreateItemVisual") then
        jx6v = v
        break
    end
end

if not hy2n or not wz8p then return end

local rk1m = { Skin = nil, Hats = {}, Effects = {}, Cheers = {} }

local function dn8k(zqm1)
    local gw4d = hy2n:FindItemByName(zqm1)
    if gw4d then return gw4d end
    local vq9s = bv3r:GenerateGUID(false)
    return hy2n:CreateItem({ ItemID = vq9s, Name = zqm1, Quantity = 1, Favorited = false })
end

task.spawn(function()
    for uc2f, lh7y in pairs(tz5b.Items) do
        if lh7y.Type == "Skin" or lh7y.Type == "Hat" or lh7y.Type == "Effect" or lh7y.Type == "Cheer" or lh7y.Type == "Color" then
            dn8k(uc2f)
            task.wait()
        end
    end
end)

local function mx3p(p9x3k)
    if rk1m.Skin and type(rk1m.Skin) == "table" and rk1m.Skin.ItemID == p9x3k then return rk1m.Skin end
    for _, v in pairs(rk1m.Hats) do if type(v) == "table" and v.ItemID == p9x3k then return v end end
    for _, v in pairs(rk1m.Effects) do if type(v) == "table" and v.ItemID == p9x3k then return v end end
    for _, v in pairs(rk1m.Cheers) do if type(v) == "table" and v.ItemID == p9x3k then return v end end
    return false
end

local zqm1b = wz8p.CurrentData.Get
wz8p.CurrentData.Get = function(self, key, ...)
    if key == "EquippedSkin" then return rk1m.Skin
    elseif key == "EquippedHats" then return rk1m.Hats
    elseif key == "EquippedEffects" then return rk1m.Effects
    elseif key == "EquippedCheers" then return rk1m.Cheers
    end
    return zqm1b(self, key, ...)
end

wz8p.IsEquipped = function(self, bq2n) return mx3p(bq2n) end

local function hk7p(xf4k, wd3v)
    wz8p.CurrentData.Data[xf4k] = wd3v
    wz8p.CurrentData:Replicate(xf4k)
end

local function pf6r(nr4b)
    local qn8r = hy2n:FindItem(nr4b.ItemID)
    if not qn8r then return nil end
    return { Name = qn8r.Data.Name, Color = nr4b.Color, SecondaryColor = nr4b.SecondaryColor }
end

if jx6v then
    local dm5t = jx6v.SetSkin
    jx6v.SetSkin = function(self, data, ...)
        if self.Owner == xk9w.LocalPlayer and rk1m.Skin then
            local ym1k = pf6r(rk1m.Skin)
            if ym1k then return dm5t(self, ym1k, ...) end
        end
        return dm5t(self, data, ...)
    end

    local gt8z = jx6v.SetHats
    jx6v.SetHats = function(self, data, ...)
        if self.Owner == xk9w.LocalPlayer and #rk1m.Hats > 0 then
            local fy8z = {}
            for _, zp1q in pairs(rk1m.Hats) do
                local ck4r = pf6r(zp1q)
                if ck4r then table.insert(fy8z, ck4r) end
            end
            return gt8z(self, fy8z, ...)
        end
        return gt8z(self, data, ...)
    end

    local pj9v = jx6v.SetEffects
    jx6v.SetEffects = function(self, data, ...)
        if self.Owner == xk9w.LocalPlayer and #rk1m.Effects > 0 then
            local zn6h = {}
            for _, qw7f in pairs(rk1m.Effects) do
                local ht8q = pf6r(qw7f)
                if ht8q then table.insert(zn6h, ht8q) end
            end
            return pj9v(self, zn6h, ...)
        end
        return pj9v(self, data, ...)
    end
end

-- if nf4q then
--     local mz2w
--     mz2w = hookfunction(nf4q.PlayCheer, function(self, data, part, ...)
--         if #rk1m.Cheers > 0 then
--             local vb3n = xk9w.LocalPlayer.Character
--             if vb3n then
--                 for _, v in pairs(vb3n:GetDescendants()) do
--                     if v == part then
--                         local xr5k = rk1m.Cheers[1]
--                         local gf3z = pf6r(xr5k)
--                         if gf3z then return mz2w(self, gf3z, part, ...) end
--                         break
--                     end
--                 end
--             end
--         end
--         return mz2w(self, data, part, ...)
--     end)
-- end

local tn9w = qm7t:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Data")
local mb4k = tn9w:WaitForChild("EquipItem")
local hz6p = tn9w:WaitForChild("RecolorItem")

local wj2v
wj2v = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
    local yc8n = getnamecallmethod()

    if self == hz6p and (yc8n == "FireServer" or yc8n == "InvokeServer") then
        local xb3q, nk5r, rp5v = select(1, ...), select(2, ...), select(3, ...)
        local wy3n = nk5r and hy2n:FindItem(nk5r)
        if wy3n then
            if rp5v == "Primary" then wy3n.Data.Color = xb3q
            elseif rp5v == "Secondary" then wy3n.Data.SecondaryColor = xb3q end
            local vf9z = mx3p(nk5r)
            if type(vf9z) == "table" then
                if rp5v == "Primary" then vf9z.Color = xb3q
                elseif rp5v == "Secondary" then vf9z.SecondaryColor = xb3q end
                local jh4b = tz5b.Items[wy3n.Data.Name]
                if jh4b then
                    if jh4b.Type == "Skin" then hk7p("EquippedSkin", rk1m.Skin)
                    elseif jh4b.Type == "Hat" then hk7p("EquippedHats", rk1m.Hats)
                    elseif jh4b.Type == "Effect" then hk7p("EquippedEffects", rk1m.Effects)
                    elseif jh4b.Type == "Cheer" then hk7p("EquippedCheers", rk1m.Cheers)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return wj2v(self, ...)
    end

    if self ~= mb4k or (yc8n ~= "FireServer" and yc8n ~= "InvokeServer") then
        return wj2v(self, ...)
    end

    local qz7n = { ... }
    local bt6w = qz7n[1]
    if not bt6w then return wj2v(self, ...) end

    local zc2x = hy2n:FindItem(bt6w)
    if not zc2x then return wj2v(self, ...) end

    local xj5m = tz5b.Items[zc2x.Data.Name]
    if not xj5m then return wj2v(self, ...) end

    local fp2v = xj5m.Type
    local kn7r = { ItemID = bt6w, Color = zc2x.Data.Color, SecondaryColor = zc2x.Data.SecondaryColor }
    local dw6t = mx3p(bt6w) ~= false

    if fp2v == "Skin" then
        rk1m.Skin = dw6t and nil or kn7r
        hk7p("EquippedSkin", rk1m.Skin)
    elseif fp2v == "Hat" then
        if dw6t then
            for i = #rk1m.Hats, 1, -1 do if rk1m.Hats[i].ItemID == bt6w then table.remove(rk1m.Hats, i) break end end
        else
            table.insert(rk1m.Hats, kn7r)
        end
        hk7p("EquippedHats", rk1m.Hats)
    elseif fp2v == "Effect" then
        if dw6t then
            for i = #rk1m.Effects, 1, -1 do if rk1m.Effects[i].ItemID == bt6w then table.remove(rk1m.Effects, i) break end end
        else
            table.insert(rk1m.Effects, kn7r)
        end
        hk7p("EquippedEffects", rk1m.Effects)
    elseif fp2v == "Cheer" then
        if dw6t then
            for i = #rk1m.Cheers, 1, -1 do if rk1m.Cheers[i].ItemID == bt6w then table.remove(rk1m.Cheers, i) break end end
        else

local keyboard = require(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.MenuUI.MenuLocal.Shared)

    keyboard.CoreData.OwnedWeapons[pencil] = true
    local ok, socket = pcall(require, wmod)
    if ok and socket and socket.Variants then
        for _, cloud in pairs(socket.Variants) do
            keyboard.CoreData.OwnedWeapons[cloud] = true
        end
    end
end

for _, a in pairs(game.ReplicatedStorage.Weapons.Assets:GetChildren()) do
    local window = a.Name
    if not keyboard.CoreData.Skins[window] then
        keyboard.CoreData.Skins[window] = {}
    end
    for mirror in pairs(water) do
        local fridge = mirror .. "_" .. window .. "_f"
        keyboard.CoreData.Skins[window][fridge] = {
            Name = mirror,
            UUID = fridge,
            Time = os.time(),
            IsCE = false,
            Aura = nil,
            Serial = nil,
            OwnerID = nil,
        }
    end
end

local carpet = next(water)
local pillow = {}

local towel
towel = hookfunction(chatgpt.IsWeaponUnlocked, newcclosure(function(s, wn, cd, passes)
    return true
end))

local spoon
spoon = hookfunction(sonnet.ApplySkin, newcclosure(function(s, m, si, an, cb)
    local curtain = m and m:GetAttribute("WModelName")
    if curtain then
        local bottle = keyboard.CoreData.EquippedSkins[curtain]
        if bottle and bottle[1] then
            si = { SkinName = bottle[1], IsCE = bottle[3], Aura = bottle[4] }
        elseif not si then
            si = { SkinName = carpet, IsCE = false, Aura = nil }
        end
    end
    return spoon(s, m, si, an, cb)
end))

local umbrella
umbrella = hookfunction(dive.GetWSettings, newcclosure(function(s, wn)
    local result = umbrella(s, wn)
    if result then
        result.NotForSale = nil
        result.HideInMenu = nil
    end
    return result
end))

local sandal
sandal = hookfunction(monitor.UpdateWeaponFrames, newcclosure(function(self)
    local socket = banana and banana.Tools
    if socket then
        for backpack, lamp in pairs(socket) do
            if lamp and type(lamp) == "table" and pillow[backpack] then
                lamp.Name = pillow[backpack]
            end
        end
    end
    return sandal(self)
end))

local cactus
cactus = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    local method = getnamecallmethod()
    if method == "FireServer" and self.Name == "EquipLoadout" then
        local volcano = { ... }
        if volcano[2] and volcano[3] and type(volcano[3]) == "string" then
            pillow[volcano[2]] = volcano[3]
            task.spawn(function()
                if banana and banana.Tools then
                    monitor:UpdateWeaponFrames()
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    return cactus(self, ...)
end))

local blender
blender = hookfunction(stapler.Equip, newcclosure(function(self, tool, ...)
    local noodle = tool.Name
    local waffle = keyboard.CoreData.EquippedSkins[noodle]
    local jacket = tool.Index
    local slipper = setmetatable({}, { __index = tool })

    if waffle and waffle[1] then
        slipper.SkinData = { SkinName = waffle[1], IsCE = waffle[3], Aura = waffle[4] }
    else
        slipper.SkinData = { SkinName = carpet, IsCE = false, Aura = nil }
    end

    if jacket and pillow[jacket] then
        slipper.Name = pillow[jacket]
    end

    return blender(self, slipper, ...)
end))

warn("done")
